title: Memory grant pressure
summary: Concurrent large sorts, each reserving a big memory grant up front: the documented MIN_GRANT_PERCENT hint asks for grantPercent of the most one query may get (25% of the workspace memory in the default workload group). Only a few fit at once, so the rest wait in the RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE queue while the buffer pool gives memory up. The sorts read appointments times a multiplier from the intensity; nothing is written.

concurrency.description: Sessions running sorts at once; at grantPercent 100 about four grants fit, so the rest queue.

intensity.description: Rows per sort (appointments times 8 per level) and a shorter pause: about 2 seconds at 1, none at 10.

notes.T3: Azure SQL Database honors MIN_GRANT_PERCENT within the service objective's memory, so the queue forms sooner at 1 vCore.

grantPercent.description: MIN_GRANT_PERCENT for each sort: the share of the per-query grant limit it reserves (100 means the whole 25% of the workspace that one query may take).

expectedHubSignals.signal: SqlServerWaitStats: Memory wait category (RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE) with several waiting tasks
SqlServerPerformanceCountersCommon: Granted Workspace Memory (KB) at its ceiling, Page life expectancy falling
SqlServerPerformanceCountersDetailed: Memory Grants Pending above 0 when the target's Detailed table lists it
expectedHubSignals.note: List the counters with the query in the telemetry page's Schema section.

expectedHubSignals.signal: SqlServerMemoryUtilization: the buffer pool clerk shrinks while the grants are held

expectedSymptoms: Sessions waiting on RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE before their sorts start
sys.dm_exec_query_memory_grants shows a few granted requests and a queue of waiting ones
Query duration grows with the queue, while CPU stays below its peak
queryLevelEvidence: sys.dm_exec_query_memory_grants: requested, granted, and waiting grants (needs VIEW SERVER STATE or VIEW DATABASE STATE)
Query Store: the sort with a large memory grant and low used memory
reset: Read-only: nothing to undo. Grants are released when each query ends or its session closes. Reset kills leftover ContosoCare.Demo/ sessions.
